name: Echoes of Kai Anders
source:
Kai Anders is missing. You need to find her. Use your empathy enhancement chip to discover clues by reading the brain waves of the last person to be seen with her. Will you be able to figure out the puzzle in this Neon Noir Visual Novel?

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/echoes-kai-anders]Global Game Jam[/url]]

Created for Global Game Jam 2017.
translation:
Kai Anders失踪了。你必须找到她。使用共情增强芯片，读取最后见过她之人的脑波，寻找线索。你能在这部霓虹黑色视觉小说中解开谜题吗？

为2017年Global Game Jam制作。

（来源：[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2017/games/echoes-kai-anders]Global Game Jam[/url]）
